subject: Northbridge: Post-Incident RCA & Action Commitments
messages:
From: hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai
To: Sarah Long <sarah.long@northbridge.ai>
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.ai, rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-07-21T08:15:00-07:00
Subject: Immediate notification — dataplane impact this morning

Hi Sarah,

I wanted to reach out as soon as we identified the issue: between 07:48–08:06 PDT this morning Northbridge traffic routed to our sfo-dataplane experienced elevated error rates and delayed tokenization, which affected inference latency and caused a subset of requests to fail with 502 responses.

We triaged and applied a targeted configuration rollback at 08:09 PDT which restored normal responses for most traffic; full normalization took until 08:20 PDT. Our on-call and incident response teams are compiling an RCA and a customer-friendly summary; I will share a concise timeline and remediation plan within 48 hours.

Immediate ask: please share any customer-facing incident IDs or high-priority accounts you want us to prioritize in our follow-up.

Attachment: (attachment stub) initial-incident-log-snippet.txt

Sorry for the disruption — we know this interrupts your workflows. I will follow up with a clear RCA and a set of corrective actions.

Best,
Hannah Schmitt
Director, Customer Reliability
Redwood Inference

From: Sarah Long <sarah.long@northbridge.ai>
To: hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai
Cc: ops@northbridge.ai
Date: 2026-07-21T09:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Immediate notification — dataplane impact this morning

Hi Hannah,

Thanks for the quick note. We had several key pipelines failing between ~07:50–08:15 PDT; our ingestion retries masked some failures but upstream customers saw increased error rates. A couple of things we need from you in the RCA:
- Whether any data was dropped or only transient failures occurred
- Root cause succinctly explained for our security/compliance team
- Estimated probability this could recur and what guardrails will be put in place

We're preparing a brief we will send to internal stakeholders; if you can provide a slide-ready one-page summary and the timeline it would be very helpful.

Regards,
Sarah Long
Head of Platform Ops
Northbridge Analytics

From: rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai
To: Sarah Long <sarah.long@northbridge.ai>
Cc: hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai, laura.bennett@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-07-22T11:30:00-07:00
Subject: Northbridge — RCA draft and concise timeline

Hi Sarah,

Apologies again for the disruption. Attached is a customer-facing RCA summary (20260721_nb_rca-summary.pdf) and a CSV timeline (dataplane-timeline.csv). Below is a short, non-technical summary suitable for your brief, followed by the factual timeline and planned actions.

Executive summary:
- Root cause: an automated roll-forward of a tokenization microservice configuration introduced a race condition during high parallelism which caused a token bucket exhaustion for new sessions, resulting in request failures and elevated latency for affected pods.
- Impact: ~3.4% of requests across the sfo-dataplane between 07:48–08:06 PDT returned 502 or timed out; no persisted customer data was deleted or modified.
- Detection & remediation: our anomaly detection alerted at 07:50; the mitigation (config rollback) was executed at 08:09 and fully validated by 08:20.
- Recurrence risk: low to moderate if the faulty config is reintroduced; mitigations below reduce likelihood to low.

Timeline (excerpt):
- 07:48 PDT: elevated error rate begins on sfo-dataplane
- 07:50 PDT: automated alert triggered; on-call paged
- 07:54 PDT: initial triage — tokenization microservice identified as suspect
- 08:02 PDT: rollback plan approved by on-call lead
- 08:09 PDT: configuration rollback applied to affected pools
- 08:20 PDT: traffic stabilized and error rate returned to baseline

Corrective actions and commitments (customer-facing):
1) Configuration gating: require canary gating and phasing for config roll-forwards in dataplane clusters (target complete: 2026-08-05)
2) Enhanced pre-deploy validation: add synthetic load tests that replicate high-parallel tokenization scenarios (target complete: 2026-07-30)
3) Improved alerting: add a tokenization-specific SLA alert and automated mitigation playbook (target complete: 2026-07-28)
4) Post-deployment review: share a PSR (post-deploy safety review) summary after each roll-forward for three consecutive deploys (period: 30 days)

We have attached the one-page PDF for your internal brief. Let us know if you want a smaller executive summary slide.

Attachments: (attachment) 20260721_nb_rca-summary.pdf, (attachment) dataplane-timeline.csv

Thanks — happy to hop on a quick call if you or your security/compliance team want to walk through it live.

— Rishi
Principal Reliability Engineer, Redwood Inference

From: hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai
To: Sarah Long <sarah.long@northbridge.ai>
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.ai, rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-07-22T15:05:00-07:00
Subject: Follow-up commitments and proposed timeline

Hi Sarah,

Following Rishi's RCA, I wanted to outline the operational commitments and concrete next steps we will take with dates so you can share with stakeholders: 

A. Immediate (this week)
- 2026-07-23: Run targeted synthetic load tests against a staging dataplane and share results (artifact link below).
- 2026-07-24: Publish the incident lessons learned memo to our shared Drive.

B. Short-term (2 weeks)
- 2026-07-28: Deploy tokenization-specific SLA alerting and automated mitigation playbook.
- 2026-07-30: Execute enhanced pre-deploy validation in CI for config changes to tokenization microservice.

C. Medium-term (2–6 weeks)
- 2026-08-05: Enforce canary gating for config roll-forwards in production clusters.
- 2026-08-20: Complete a retrospective and produce a public-facing runbook update for customers explaining safe deployment practices and mitigation options.

We will also set up a recurring 30-minute sync for the next 4 weeks to share progress and make sure you have early visibility on any related changes. Proposed first sync: 2026-07-24 10:00 PDT — confirm if that works for your team.

Attachments: (attachment) proposed-mitigations.xlsx
Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/0B_example_nb_rca
HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/record/ENG-7890

If you need any compliance-specific artifacts (logs, signed attestation), tell me which items to prioritize and we will route them to your security contacts.

Best,
Hannah Schmitt
Director, Customer Reliability
Redwood Inference

From: Sarah Long <sarah.long@northbridge.ai>
To: hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai
Cc: ops@northbridge.ai, laura.bennett@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-07-23T16:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Northbridge: Post-Incident RCA & Action Commitments

Thanks Hannah and team — this is very helpful and timely. We appreciate the clear timeline and the slide-ready PDF. A few quick notes:
- We will accept the proposed sync on 07/24 at 10:00 PDT.
- Please prioritize the synthetic load test artifact and the tokenization alerting before the sync so we can validate internally.
- Our security team will request logs and the attestation referenced; I will loop them into the 07/24 meeting if needed.

Once we have the artifacts we will close the incident in our tracker and share the postmortem internally.

Best,
Sarah
Head of Platform Ops
Northbridge Analytics
